migrations.description: Core tables + seed
Workflow RPCs + row-ownership RLS
Records (admin_comment + item RPCs) + requester capture
Enable RLS on purchase_requests + line_items (policies were inert)
Phase 2a: product-images bucket + get_app_secret + get_permission_holders
Phase 2b: approval-summary notification guard
Phase 3a: comment attribution (commented_by/at) + wider gate + 100-char cap
Phase 3a fix: get_user_names resolver (client can't read others' user_profiles)
Phase 3b: get_formatting_rules read RPC (conditional formatting)
Phase 4 QA: request_number sequence + per-item line_no trigger + backfill
Phase 4 QA: cancel approved item -> cancelled; rollup + CHECK updates
Phase 4 QA: replacement returns route to approved (Purchasing); backfill replacement_ordered
Phase 4 QA: mark processed returns (return_processed_at) so they leave the Returns queue
Phase 5: Purchase Orders (purchase_orders table + create/close RPCs + receive auto-close)
Phase 5 fix: allow admins to close purchase orders
Phase 6: public request form (submit_request_anon RPC + anon RLS)
Hard-deleted empty requests (delete_line_item) + cancel stamps approved_by
Requester confirmation email fallback to auth.users.email
Restrict anon INSERT policies to public-form submissions only
Allow public_form as a submission_source value
Every individual order creates a single-item PO
Cancel button applies to ordered items and updates PO status
Allow anon read on active locations/departments for public form dropdowns
Record requester name on private-form submissions
Allow requesters to read public/private form submissions via requester_email
Extend email RLS fallback to user_profiles.email for SSO users (no JWT email)
NULLIF empty JWT email claim (SSO issues "email":""), COALESCE missed the profile fallback
Records archive: line_items.archived_at + archive_line_item RPC (soft delete replaces UI delete)
Favorite items catalog (admin-curated, form auto-suggestions) + RLS
Converge favorite_items RLS: drop loose per-action policies, canonical read-all / admin-write only
Heart button: any signed-in user can INSERT favorites from the Requests page (update/delete stay admin)
Favorites: only approvers/purchasers/admins may insert; trigger stamps created_by for Added-by attribution
Pre-approved items catalog (table + RLS + created_by trigger) + line_items reporting columns (received_at, cancelled_at, pre_approved_item_id)
Pre-approved RPCs (pre_approve_line_item, order_pre_approved_item, delete_pre_approved_item) + receive_line_item v2 / cancel_line_item v3 with received_at/cancelled_at stamps
Pre-approve is catalog-only (no auto-approval); item stays in For Approval; catalog upsert unchanged
Wave C: request_comments thread table + RLS + realtime publication + admin_comment backfill
Wave C: purchase_requests.last_overdue_reminder_at (14-day reminder dedupe column)
Wave C: pg_cron job for daily 08:00 overdue reminders (net.http_post -> procurement-capture-and-notify)
